subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Social Proof and Herd Behavior
description: A short lesson to help you apply Social Proof and Herd Behavior.

hook.text: If your doctor, your pastor, and your neighbor all invested, it must be safe — right?

buildup.text: Social proof is a mental shortcut: if trusted people did it, we skip our own research.

discovery.text: Ponzi operators deliberately recruit community leaders first. Their endorsement is the real product.

twist.text: The more people who join, the more legitimate it appears — creating a self-reinforcing illusion.

climax.text: By the time doubts surface, admitting the truth means calling everyone you know a fool.

punchline.text: Following the crowd into a Ponzi scheme doesn't make it safe.

quiz.question: Why do Ponzi operators target community leaders first?
